summary.description: 1-2 short plain-text sentences for a chat notification: what broke and why, readable without opening the report. No markdown, no code blocks, no file paths unless essential.

root_cause.description: One paragraph: the underlying cause, traced upstream to its real origin.

repo.description: ORG/REPO where the cause lives, or empty string.

file.description: Path to the culprit file, or empty string.

evidence.description: The exact log line or code snippet that proves the cause.

fix.description: Concrete fix: a code change (which repo/file/what) or, if not code, the action to take on the build machine/environment.

agent.description: Jenkins agent/node the stage ran on, as seen in the log (e.g. NODE_NAME), or empty string.

remediation.description: Only for category environment or tooling: ordered steps for whoever maintains the build agent - first confirm the diagnosis, then fix, then verify. Empty array for code or dependency causes.

action.description: What to do and why, one or two sentences.

command.description: Exact command(s) to run on that agent's OS, or empty string if the step is not a command.
